claims.statement: For the full production bls12-381-fixed-g2-invert-g1 challenge, the STNFS algorithm of this package recovers P in G1 with e(P,Q) = z for the exact supplied nonidentity Q (P = infinity for z = 1) with success at least 0.39 over uniform challenges and fresh algorithm coins (modelled 0.6016; 0.4023 even at E_true = 1.5E'): success = (1 - 2^-190) x (1 - P(abort)), P(abort) <= 1.5E'/cap <= 0.40. The yield premise is measured, not fitted: 159,744 exact-norm production points (all 66 descent bins and the boot; the record CAMPAIGN17.txt.b85 is archived with its pre-registered gates re-verified in [5n]) measured the joint distinct-yield statistic against the charged product at every bin — every bin clears its 3.3-sigma floor (worst 4.07, boot 3.94). The charged expectation degrades the aggregate yield product x0.75 at every node AND in the boot trial denominator (one component x0.75, or all four x0.9301): E_rob = 2^119.805016, E' = 2^120.497475, per-component x0.75 printed infeasible live. The boot is charged at the relation-level psi_boot = 0.657229 under conditional domination, E[#balls] <= 2.91740 on the collection share; the conditional (smoothness-selected) UDUP is measured and the earlier exact-transfer claim is withdrawn — only P x UDUP enters mu, and the joint statistic contains the conditional selection per point. A global meter bounds all classical work — preprocessing, failures, restarts, transfers, storage, verification and output — by W <= 2^123.35 dense-Fp12-multiplication units at C = 20,000 scalar AArch64 instructions; the ledger totals 2^123.320655 (relcol 2^121.9501, LA 2^119.7003, cap 2^122.41 above log2(1.5E'/0.40) = 122.4044, small 2^90.3231), reproduced exactly by the deterministic in-sandbox recompute. The construction, derivations and disclosures are in the in-archive PROOF.md; the experiment prints 23 named checks including the record gates [5n]. Nothing is amortised over future targets.

experiments.purpose: Recomputes in-sandbox everything specified in the in-archive PROOF.md, with 23 named checks ([0]-[8]: the tower certificates with the f-field bridge and the non-square witness (N(D) = 8 mod 31), the discriminant identities, the pool, the measurement parse with the compressed-kernel sha256, the relation-collection ledger at the calibrated s*, the linear-algebra charge, the retention laws and E-ladder with the honest aggregate and its infeasibility rows, the record gates [5n] re-verified from the rounded rows, the cap grid with the relation-level boot restart and the conditional-domination chain, the total, and the storage arithmetic). The output is self-contained and its quoted_offline list states the evidence split.
